edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller. The Purchase Price shall not be subject to set-off, counterclaim, or reduction, except as expressly provided in this Agreement.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur remotely by exchange of executed documents and funds no later than 30 days after the date of this Agreement, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to Closing expressly set forth in this Agreement. The Buyer shall use commercially reasonable efforts to consummate the transactions contemplated by this Agreement promptly.

3. Representations. The Seller represents that, except as set forth in the disclosure schedules, the financial statements delivered to the Buyer were prepared in accordance with the accounting principles stated therein, consistently applied, and fairly present in all material respects the financial condition of the Seller as of their respective dates and the results of operations for the periods covered thereby. The Seller makes no representation or warranty other than those expressly set forth in this Agreement. Each representation and warranty is subject to the qualifications and limitations expressly stated in this Agreement.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep confidential the existence and terms of this Agreement and any non-public information received from the other party in connection with the transactions contemplated hereby, and shall not disclose such information except to its representatives who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations, as required by law or applicable regulation, or with the other party’s prior written consent. A party making a legally required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.

edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 42,500,000 in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller. The Purchase Price is fixed and shall not be subject to any post-Closing adjustment, set-off, counterclaim, escrow, holdback, or reduction. The Buyer’s obligation to pay the Purchase Price is not conditioned on obtaining financing or on completion of due diligence.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur remotely by exchange of executed documents and funds no later than 30 days after the date of this Agreement. The Buyer’s obligation to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby shall be subject only to the Seller’s delivery of the closing deliverables expressly specified in this Agreement and the absence of a final, non-appealable order prohibiting Closing. The Buyer shall use commercially reasonable efforts to consummate the transactions promptly and shall not be entitled to delay or terminate Closing based on financing or the completion or outcome of due diligence.

3. Representations. The Seller represents only that: (a) it is duly organized, validly existing, and has authority to execute and perform this Agreement; (b) this Agreement has been duly authorized and executed by the Seller and is binding upon it, subject to customary bankruptcy and equitable principles; (c) the Seller owns the shares being sold, free of liens created by the Seller; and (d) the financial statements delivered to the Buyer were prepared in accordance with the accounting principles stated therein, consistently applied, and fairly present in all material respects the financial condition of the Seller as of their respective dates and results of operations for the periods covered thereby. The foregoing representations are subject to the disclosure schedules delivered with this Agreement and to the qualifications and limitations expressly stated herein. They survive Closing for 12 months, except the representations in clauses (a) through (c), which survive for 24 months. The Seller makes no other representation or warranty, express or implied. Any indemnification for breach of the foregoing representations shall be the Buyer’s exclusive remedy, subject to an aggregate cap equal to 5% of the Purchase Price and a tipping basket equal to 1% of the Purchase Price; no claim may be recovered unless the aggregate of covered losses exceeds that basket, in which case recovery is limited to losses in excess of the basket. No escrow or purchase-price retention shall apply. These limitations do not apply to a party’s fraud.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep confidential the existence and terms of this Agreement and any non-public information received from the other party in connection with the transactions contemplated hereby, and shall not disclose such information except to its representatives, financing sources, and professional advisers who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations, as required by law or applicable regulation, or with the other party’s prior written consent. These restrictions do not apply to information that the receiving party can demonstrate (a) was already known to it without a duty of confidentiality, (b) was independently developed without use of or reference to the disclosing party’s confidential information, or (c) was obtained from a source not known by the receiving party to be under a duty of confidentiality. A party making a legally required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.

receiver.private_reasoning: The Seller has reduced its price by $2.5 million but paired that concession with a fixed, unconditional cash obligation, narrow representations, and highly restrictive remedies. To prioritize price while making a credible final-round counter, propose $40 million and offer a defined diligence period rather than an open-ended condition. Seek meaningful operational representations and practical recourse; do not assume the Seller’s stated position is its bottom line.

receiver.requested_changes: Counter at USD 40,000,000 in cash at Closing. Closing may occur within 45 days, subject to customary closing conditions, including a defined 15-business-day Buyer diligence period with a right to terminate for unsatisfactory diligence and satisfaction of the agreed conditions. The Buyer is prepared not to make financing a condition to Closing if the price and other protections are agreed. Expand the Seller’s representations to cover customary matters for a share sale, including capitalization, subsidiaries, financial statements, absence of undisclosed liabilities, compliance with law, material contracts, taxes, employees, litigation, title to assets, and brokers, with appropriate materiality and disclosed-schedule qualifications. Provide a 24-month general survival period, longer survival for fundamental and tax representations, a 15% cap for general representation claims and no cap for fundamental representations and fraud, and an escrow equal to 10% of the Purchase Price for general claims. Replace the 1% tipping basket with a deductible basket of 0.5% of the Purchase Price. Preserve the reciprocal confidentiality exceptions, including disclosure to financing sources, subject to customary confidentiality obligations.
receiver.message_back: Thank you for the revised draft. The Seller’s proposed price and terms do not provide the Buyer with an acceptable combination of value and protection, particularly given the unconditional payment obligation and the limited representations and recourse. As a basis for resolving the remaining issues, the Buyer proposes USD 40,000,000 in cash at Closing, with a 45-day outside date and a defined 15-business-day diligence period. The Buyer is willing to proceed without a financing condition, provided Closing remains subject to customary conditions and the Buyer has the stated, time-limited diligence termination right. We also propose customary, appropriately qualified seller representations and the survival, cap, basket, and escrow terms summarized above. We are willing to discuss specific, proportionate limits, but cannot accept a 5% cap, a 1% tipping basket, and no escrow as the sole practical recourse for the proposed representations. Please let us know whether the Seller is prepared to engage on this basis.
